description: This PHP class file defines a database migration script for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.2. It extends an abstract migration class, adding columns to existing tables, inserting new module data, and creating menu items with associated permissions and navigation structure.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for version 4.2, handling schema updates and menu structure for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the schema updates, data insertions, and menu setup for the migration.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert menu items into the database with specified attributes.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Retrieves the screen ID associated with a specified action URL.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '4.2'.
